caption: Man tries to defend bike thief — nearly gets his own scooter stolen.
A viral video shows a man stepping in to stop another person from beating an alleged bike thief who had just been caught trying to steal a bicycle.
The man arrived on a scooter and told the victim to calm down and stop hitting the suspect.

Seconds later, the alleged thief suddenly jumped up from the ground and tried to steal the scooter belonging to the man who defended him. The scooter owner quickly grabbed him by the neck and dragged him back off the scooter before he could escape.
The clip quickly exploded online, with many users saying the moment proved “reality is the fastest teacher alive.”
